description: This file defines a Java class 'FilterJars' implementing the 'JarScanFilter' interface. It contains a method to determine whether certain JAR files should be included based on properties and the JAR name.

classes.name: FilterJars
classes.description: A class implementing JarScanFilter, used to filter JAR files during scanning, based on configuration properties and JAR name.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Determines if a JAR file should be included in the scan based on the 'webSocket' property and whether the JAR name contains 'ofbiz.jar'.
